## What's new

**Dashboards you can find again, and share.** A result pinned with *Add to dashboard* was kept, but once its tab was closed only the command palette led back to it.

- **In the Saved tab.** A connection's dashboards are listed there above its saved queries, with Open, Rename and Delete; the search box covers both. *Query → Dashboards* opens the overview. An open dashboard is back after a restart.
- **In the knowledge base.** When a connection has a knowledge base, a dashboard is a file in it, `dashboards/<name>.md`: a heading and an SQL block with its chart per tile, readable on GitHub and editable by hand. Whoever shares the folder (Git, OneDrive, a team folder) has the dashboard; a file changed by a teammate is picked up by an open dashboard. Without a knowledge base dashboards stay on your computer, and one you already have moves into the folder only when you say so (*Move to the knowledge base*).
- **Always per connection.** A dashboard belongs to the database it was made on and is never offered on another.
- **Tiles only read.** Every tile runs behind the read-only guard, also on a connection that allows writing, so a dashboard from somebody else can't change anything; a tile that isn't a read is refused.
- **The assistant knows the format.** With a knowledge base and permission to write to it, "make me a dashboard of orders per month" writes the file, after your confirmation as for every knowledge base file.

**Also fixed**

- Pinning a result to a dashboard that was open in a tab could lose the new tile on that tab's next save.
- A deleted dashboard's tab says so instead of waiting forever.
- New dashboards never repeat a name after one was deleted.

Everything new in 1.5 is in the [1.5.0 notes](https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/tag/v1.5.0).

Updates itself on Windows (installer), macOS and Linux (AppImage). The [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) version updates through the Store.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| Windows, signed by Microsoft | [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) |
| Windows, no installation | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.3-win-x64-portable.zip`: unzip and run `DB Mastermind.exe` |
| Windows installer (no admin, updates itself) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.3-win-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows for IT (per machine) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.3-win-x64.msi` |
| Windows via Scoop | `scoop install https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/latest/download/db-mastermind.json` |
| macOS | `…-mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) / `…-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel), or `brew tap elh0m3r0/db-mastermind https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind && brew install --cask db-mastermind`. First launch: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (the app is not notarized yet) |
| Linux | `DB-Mastermind-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (updates itself; needs FUSE 2, `libfuse2t64` on Ubuntu 24.04) or `.deb` |
| MCP server and command line | `npx -y dbmastermind-mcp` · `npx -p dbmastermind-mcp dbm` |
